summary: A small wrapper around C standard-library file handles.

types.name: struct file
types.description: A struct that owns a C FILE handle while it remains open.

functions.name: open
functions.signature: std::optional::opt<file> file::open(const char* path, const char* mode)
functions.description: Opens a file using a C standard-library mode string.
functions.returnDescription: Some file on success or none when opening fails.

functions.name: write
functions.signature: void file::write(file& this, const char* data)
functions.description: Writes a null-terminated string to an open file.

functions.name: write_line
functions.signature: void file::write_line(file& this, const char* data)
functions.description: Writes a null-terminated string followed by a newline.

functions.name: flush
functions.description: Flushes buffered output for an open file.

functions.name: read_line
functions.signature: void file::read_line(file& this, char* buffer, u64 buffer_size)
functions.description: Reads a line into a caller-provided buffer.

parameters.name: buffer_size
parameters.description: The capacity of the destination buffer.

functions.name: read
functions.signature: void file::read(file& this, char* buffer, u64 buffer_size)
functions.description: Reads bytes into a caller-provided buffer.

functions.name: read_to_string
functions.description: Reads the remaining file contents into a string.
functions.returnDescription: A string containing the remaining contents.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Closes a file handle and releases the wrapper.
